source: User-supplied UGC NET Economics NET Syllabus, Subject Economics, Code No. 01 (4 pages)

units.name: Micro Economics
units.playlist_title: UGC NET Economics Unit 1 | Micro Economics | DigvijayEconLab
units.playlist_description: Complete bilingual UGC NET Economics Unit 1: Micro Economics. Topic-wise lessons on consumer behaviour, production and costs, risk, game theory, market structures, factor pricing, general equilibrium, efficiency, welfare economics and asymmetric information.
topics: Decision Making under Uncertainty and Attitude towards Risk
Market Structures: Competitive and Non-Competitive Equilibria and Efficiency Properties
Efficiency Criteria: Pareto-Optimality, Kaldor-Hicks and Wealth Maximization
Welfare Economics: Fundamental Theorems and Social Welfare Function
Asymmetric Information: Adverse Selection and Moral Hazard

units.name: Macro Economics
units.playlist_title: UGC NET Economics Unit 2 | Macro Economics | DigvijayEconLab
units.playlist_description: Complete bilingual UGC NET Economics Unit 2: Macro Economics. National income, classical and Keynesian output and employment, consumption, investment, multiplier, accelerator, money demand and supply, IS-LM, inflation, Phillips curve, business cycles and policy.
topics: Determination of Output and Employment: Classical and Keynesian Approaches
Rational Expectations Hypothesis and Its Critique

units.name: Statistics and Econometrics
units.playlist_title: UGC NET Economics Unit 3 | Statistics and Econometrics | DigvijayEconLab
units.playlist_description: Complete bilingual UGC NET Economics Unit 3: Statistics and Econometrics. Probability, distributions, moments, central limit theorem, descriptive statistics, sampling, inference, regression, identification, simultaneous equations, discrete choice and time series.
topics: Probability Theory: Concepts, Distributions, Moments and Central Limit Theorem
Descriptive Statistics: Central Tendency, Dispersion, Correlation and Index Numbers
Linear Regression Models and Their Properties: BLUE
Simultaneous Equation Models: Recursive and Non-Recursive

units.name: Mathematical Economics
units.playlist_title: UGC NET Economics Unit 4 | Mathematical Economics | DigvijayEconLab
units.playlist_description: Complete bilingual UGC NET Economics Unit 4: Mathematical Economics. Sets, functions, continuity, sequences, series, differential calculus, linear algebra, static optimization, input-output models, linear programming and difference and differential equations.
topics: Sets, Functions, Continuity, Sequences and Series
Linear Algebra: Matrices and Vector Spaces
Static Optimization Problems and Their Applications
Difference and Differential Equations with Applications

units.name: International Economics
units.playlist_title: UGC NET Economics Unit 5 | International Economics | DigvijayEconLab
units.playlist_description: Complete bilingual UGC NET Economics Unit 5: International Economics. Trade concepts and theories, imperfect competition, balance of payments, exchange rates, foreign exchange markets, gains from trade, tariffs, WTO, regional trade blocs, IMF and World Bank.
topics: International Trade: Basic Concepts and Analytical Tools
Balance of Payments: Composition, Equilibrium, Disequilibrium and Adjustment Mechanisms
Gains from Trade, Terms of Trade and Trade Multiplier
Tariff and Non-Tariff Barriers to Trade; Dumping
GATT, WTO, Regional Trade Blocs and Trade Policy Issues

units.name: Public Economics
units.playlist_title: UGC NET Economics Unit 6 | Public Economics | DigvijayEconLab
units.playlist_description: Complete bilingual UGC NET Economics Unit 6: Public Economics. Market failure, public goods, externalities, regulation, public revenue, taxation, tax incidence, public expenditure, public debt, budgets and fiscal policy.
topics: Market Failure and Remedial Measures: Asymmetric Information, Public Goods and Externality
Regulation of Market: Collusion and Consumers’ Welfare
Public Revenue: Tax and Non-Tax Revenue; Direct and Indirect Taxes
Progressive and Non-Progressive Taxation: Incidence and Effects of Taxation
Public Budget, Budget Multiplier and Fiscal Policy Implications

units.name: Money and Banking
units.playlist_title: UGC NET Economics Unit 7 | Money and Banking | DigvijayEconLab
units.playlist_description: Complete bilingual UGC NET Economics Unit 7: Money and Banking. Money supply, central bank, commercial banking, monetary policy instruments, non-banking financial institutions and capital market regulation.
topics: Instruments and Working of Monetary Policy

units.name: Growth and Development Economics
units.playlist_title: UGC NET Economics Unit 8 | Growth and Development Economics | DigvijayEconLab
units.playlist_description: Complete bilingual UGC NET Economics Unit 8: Growth and Development Economics. Growth and development concepts, development theories, growth models, technical progress, endogenous growth, development indicators, poverty, inequality and social sector development.
topics: Theories of Economic Development: Adam Smith, Ricardo, Marx, Schumpeter and Rostow
Balanced and Unbalanced Growth; Big Push Approach
Models of Economic Growth: Harrod-Domar, Solow, Robinson and Kaldor
Technical Progress: Disembodied, Embodied and Endogenous Growth
Indicators of Economic Development: PQLI, HDI and SDGs
Poverty and Inequalities: Concepts and Measurement; Social Sector Development: Health, Education and Gender

units.name: Environmental Economics and Demography
units.playlist_title: UGC NET Economics Unit 9 | Environmental Economics and Demography | DigvijayEconLab
units.playlist_description: Complete bilingual UGC NET Economics Unit 9: Environmental Economics and Demography. Environment as public good, market failure, Coase theorem, cost-benefit analysis, valuation, population theories, fertility, morbidity, mortality, age structure, demographic dividend, life table and migration.
topics: Fertility, Morbidity and Mortality: Concepts and Measures

units.name: Indian Economy
units.playlist_title: UGC NET Economics Unit 10 | Indian Economy | DigvijayEconLab
units.playlist_description: Complete bilingual UGC NET Economics Unit 10: Indian Economy. Growth patterns, agriculture, industry, services, rural and urban development, foreign trade, capital flows, infrastructure, land, labour and capital market reforms, Centre-State relations, Finance Commissions, FRBM, poverty, inequality and unemployment.
topics: Economic Growth in India: Pattern and Structure
Agriculture: Pattern and Structure of Growth, Major Challenges and Policy Responses
Industry: Pattern and Structure of Growth, Major Challenges and Policy Responses
Services: Pattern and Structure of Growth, Major Challenges and Policy Responses
Rural Development: Issues, Challenges and Policy Responses
Urban Development: Issues, Challenges and Policy Responses
Foreign Trade: Structure and Direction, Balance of Payments, Foreign Capital Flows and Trade Policies
Infrastructure Development: Physical and Social Infrastructure; Public-Private Partnerships
Reforms in Land, Labour and Capital Markets
Centre-State Financial Relations, Finance Commissions of India, FRBM, Poverty, Inequality and Unemployment
